name: Zelinda
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 654 Zelinda: diameter 160.736 ± 1.342 km; JPL's stated reference: urn:nasa:pds:neowise_diameters_albedos::2.0[mainbelt] (http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...759L...8M)
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 160.736 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Zelinda. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
introduction: A. Kopff found Zelinda at Heidelberg on 4 January 1908.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 160.736 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
